title: Galois-Ring Diffusion for Integer-Ring Ciphers
summary: The paper analyzes matrix-based diffusion for integer-ring ciphers, while constructing and analyzing a Galois-ring diffusion alternative remains open.

formal_statement.body: Study how to construct and analyze a cipher over $\mathbb{Z}_{p^n}^{\,t}$ in which the matrix multiplication $M$ is replaced by a function over $\operatorname{GR}(p^n,t)$ that provides diffusion.

scope.domain: Design and analysis of integer-ring ciphers with Galois-ring diffusion.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct and analyze the cipher obtained by replacing matrix multiplication M with a diffusion-providing function over the Galois ring.

citations.label: The ABC of Symmetric Primitives over Integer Rings: Milk Before Meat

progress.summary: The source analyzes SPNs with matrix-multiplication diffusion and explicitly leaves the Galois-ring function alternative open for future work.
citation_labels: Tim Beyne et al., The ABC of Symmetric Primitives over Integer Rings: Milk Before Meat
